// line comment above a class
class Account {
  #balance = 0;
  static version = "1.0";

  constructor(owner, { currency = "usd" } = {}) {
    this.owner = owner;
    this.currency = currency;
  }

  /* block comment above a method */
  deposit(amount) {
    this.#balance += amount;
    return this.#balance;
  }

  get balance() {
    return this.#balance;
  }
}

function topLevel(x, ...rest) {
  const { a, b } = x;
  return a + b + rest.length;
}

const arrow = (y) => y * 2;
const Klass = class {
  run() {
    return 1;
  }
};

const obj = { key: 1, shorthand, [computed]: 2 };
const name = "world";
const greeting = `hello ${name}, total ${1 + 2}`;
const pattern = /^[a-z]+$/gi;
